meta.description: fr-022 ein.schlag (party version) by farbrausch, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 3) taken from the release executable of fr-022 ein.schlag (party version), carved by v2redux at its own format version (`corpus/embedded/fr022_party.v2m`). 120 BPM, 5:04, 14 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. Against the v2redux reference render it differs by +0.08 dB loudness and at most 0.43 @ 2000 Hz in any octave band (tools/unisynth-parity, A/B listening approved 2026-10-28).
